source.post_text:
Anne Hathaway when asked what her favourite line from ‘THE ODYSSEY’ is:

“‘Somebody get these beggars out of here!’ — People are using that one savagely and I’m here for it.”

(Via @EW)

replies.text: It's wild how that Odyssey line about the beggars still slaps so hard today, Anne totally gets why people are weaponizing it online.
